mapper.select: SELECT banner_id, title, eyebrow, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, link2_label, link2_url, link2_target, bg_color, sort_order, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM banner WHERE is_active = 1 AND started_at <= NOW() AND ended_at >= NOW() ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT banner_id, title, eyebrow, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, link2_label, link2_url, link2_target, bg_color, sort_order, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM banner ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT banner_id, title, eyebrow, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, link2_label, link2_url, link2_target, bg_color, sort_order, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM banner WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner(title, eyebrow, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, link2_label, link2_url, link2_target, bg_color, sort_order, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_by) VALUES( #{title}, #{eyebrow}, #{subtitle}, #{imageKey}, #{linkUrl}, #{linkTarget}, #{linkLabel}, #{link2Label}, #{link2Url}, #{link2Target}, #{bgColor}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET is_active = #{isActive} WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
UPDATE banner SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
